title: WPMS/2413/2019 of HARNEK SINGH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPMS No. 2413 of 2019
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. S.K. Mandal, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. M.S. Bisht, Brief Holder for the
State of Uttarakhand/ respondent nos. 1 to
3.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
According to the petitioner, he is a co-tenure holder in respect of Khata Khatauni
No. 24, Plot No. 154 (min) area 0.4334
hectare, which was acquired under the
provisions of the National Highways Act,
1956 for construction of National Highway-74.
According to the petitioner, award has
been made by the Special Land Acquisition
Officer on 21.01.2015.
Grievance of the petitioner is that
petitioner had not been paid any
compensation so far while other co-tenure
holders have been paid the first installment
of the compensation. Now petitioner
apprehends that the second installment of
compensation would also be released in
favour of other co-tenure holders, who are
impleaded as respondent nos. 4 to 9 in this
writ petition leaving the petitioner high and
dry. Thus, feeling aggrieved, petitioner has
approached this Court seeking the following
reliefs:-
ìI. Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus directing and
commanding the respondent no. 3 to pay the
compensation amount 1/3 share of the
acquired land of the petitioner situated in
Khata Khatunni no. 24, Khasra no. 154, area
0.4334 hectare, situated in village Madaiya
Ratan, Pargana Gadarpur, Tehsil Bazpur,
District Udham Singh Nagar immediately.

II. Issue a writ, order or direction in the
nature of mandamus directing and
commanding the respondent no. 3 not to
release any amount to the private respondent
no. 4 to 9 beyond their limit of share of plot
Khata Khatuni no. 24, Khasra no. 154, area
0.4334 hectare, situated in village Madaiya
Ratan, Pargana Gadarpur, Tehsil Bazpur,
District Udham Singh Nagar.î
Section 3H(3) of the National Highways
Act, 1956 provides ìwhere several persons
claim to be interested in the amount
deposited under sub-section (1), the
competent authority shall determine the
persons who in its opinion are entitled to
receive the amount payable to each of them.î
In view of the specific provision
contained in Section 3H(3) of the aforesaid
Act, petitioner has a remedy to approach the
competent authority for ratable
apportionment of amount of compensation
amongst co-tenure holders.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that petitioner has already
approached the competent authority by
making an application on 18.06.2019.
Therefore, the writ petition is disposed
of with a direction to the competent
authority to look into the grievance raised by
the petitioner and pass appropriate order in
accordance with law within three weeks from
the date of production of certified copy of
this court.
It is made clear that amount of
compensation, if any, shall be released only
after decision on petitionerís application.
